text:
Samir: quick question — if we need to immediately disable the predictor-v2 rollout (canary ~5%), who is authorized to flip it? I'm about to escalate.
Priya: Ops leads + Eng oncall can flip. Execs don't need to be involved for emergency stop.
Mateo: Confirmed. Policy in runbook: oncall + eng-sre. Add a comment when flipping so audit shows reason.
Samir: where's the exact command? trying to be ready to act now.
Jin: use this (internal):
```
redwood-flagctl disable predictor-v2 --scope=canary --metadata "hotstop:production-2026-03-18;owner=Samir"
```
Tess: if you flip, notify #incidents and paging: incident PD rotation. Also set severity and attach a link to the failing eval set.
Priya: Also make sure to add tag `postmortem-required` in the comment so the runbook picks it up.
Samir: @Tess @Mateo I'm seeing ~3x error rate on logs, prefixed with kv-cache miss spike. I'm going to prepare the disable command. Who will press if I'm out?
Mateo: I'll take the flip if you get paged elsewhere — I'm online for next hour.
ops-bot: automated reminder: per policy, any flag flip must include a short rationale and a link to telemetry. Audit entry saved at /audit/flags/2976543210.
Jin: After disabling, check model fallbacks. If fallback hits > 10% for 15m, re-enable canary at 1% and notify.
Samir: flipping in T-20s, I'll paste the exact audit comment here after.
Samir: (action) ran: `redwood-flagctl disable predictor-v2 --scope=canary --metadata "hotstop:prod-2026-03-18;owner=Samir;reason=kv-cache-spike"` :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: flag predictor-v2 disabled for canary by Samir at 2026-03-18T15:42:10Z. Audit: /audit/flags/2976543210/log
Tess: thanks — I'll create a brief incident thread and assign postmortem owner. Pinged infra-team for KV cache traces.
Mateo: added a temporary watch on latency dashboards and set a muted alert to avoid pager spam.
Priya: Good. Keep the flag off until root cause identified + postmortem. If rollback safe, we can re-enable with stricter rate limits.
Samir: noted. I'll drop the telemetry links in #incidents and tag the postmortem doc. thanks all :pray:
